data.long_meaning: Mrunal is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'mruna' which means delight, charm, enchant or be intoxicated. It is a name of the moon god, Chandra, and is also associated with Lord Krishna. The name Mrunal carries the meaning “Delight, Charm, Enchant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mrunal usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, charm, enchant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
